name: application-card
title: Card
description: Media, eyebrow/title/description, and an optional author + action row inside a bordered surface.
useWhen: Presenting a single piece of content — an article, product, or update — with an optional image and a clear action.
Grouping related information (title, description, metadata) inside a visually distinct, self-contained surface.
Building a grid or list of similar items, such as a blog index or product catalog.
avoidWhen: The content is a single short KPI or number — use `stat-tile` instead, which is purpose-built for that density.
You need a clickable preview that appears on hover over a trigger — use `hover-card` instead.
The layout has no natural title or grouping — a bare container without the card chrome is lighter weight.
responsiveBehavior: Fills its container width; the image maintains a fixed height and crops via object-cover so the card holds its shape at any width.
accessibility: The image's alt text should be empty (decorative) unless it conveys information the title/description doesn't already provide.
The action is a real <button> so it is reachable and operable via keyboard.
Heading level for the title should be chosen by the surrounding page structure, not hardcoded to always be an h3.

variants.title: Card
variants.description: Image, eyebrow, title, description, author, and an action button.
accessibility: Decorative content image uses an empty alt attribute; the author avatar is similarly decorative since the name is present as text.

variants.title: Card (Dark)
variants.description: Image, eyebrow, title, description, author, and an action button, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Text and border colors are tuned to meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark surface.
